title: Workforce
subtitle: Services that answer from your knowledge, for callers outside openKMS.
empty: No workforce agents yet. Create one to publish a knowledge base as a service.
cardCreateHint: Name it, then bind the knowledge it may answer from.
name: Name
descriptionPlaceholder: What this service is for, and who calls it.
modelHint: Which chat model answers. The default uses the one the system is configured with; a specific model may come from another service.
skillsHint: What it may do besides reading. The core skills are always on.
schemaLookup: Look up the model before querying
retrieveOnMiss: Only when the first pass misses
maxToolRoundsHint: Upper bound on tool calls in one turn. Empty means no limit.
workspaceHint: Let the agent keep files in the conversation's own folder.
sandboxHint: Runs commands inside the conversation folder, with a time limit and an output cap.
knowledgeLead: Which knowledge sources this agent answers from. Each question names one source.
noReadableKbs: You can read no knowledge bases yet.
dataLead: The Catalog models and ontology groups this agent may consult when it answers with numbers or objects.
modelBound: Binding a model lets the agent use that model's metrics as evidence.
groupBound: Binding a group lets the agent read those object types and links.
credentialCreatedBody: Shown once — close this and it cannot be viewed again.
revokeConfirm: Revoke credential "{{name}}"? Any caller using it stops working.
archiveConfirm: Delete "{{name}}"? Its credentials stop working immediately and it leaves this list; saved conversations and audit records are kept.
readOnlyNote: A credential can read and ask. It cannot change anything.
chatPickSourceLead: A conversation stays with one source. Pick the one to talk to {{name}} about.

chat.toastNewChatFailed: Could not start a new chat
chat.saveAsFaqAria: Save this answer as a new FAQ
chat.heroSubtitle: Ask questions about documents, linked wiki pages, and FAQs in this knowledge base.
chat.composerHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
chat.empty: Ask a question to get started
chat.dataEvidenceAria: Catalog query results used in this answer

sourceUsage.usedHint: Numbers in the answer come from this source.

chat.filesEmpty: This conversation has not produced any files yet.
chat.filesResizeHint: Drag to resize the files panel

profileLead: Name, description, and the instructions it answers with.
skillsLead: What the agent can do besides reading the corpus.
toolsLead: What it may look up and what it may run.
toolsEnvHint: Two capabilities that touch the session's own folder.
credentialsLead: Credentials belong to this agent alone; revoking one stops this service and leaves your own sign-in alone.
endpointHint: POST here with a credential from the list, naming one bound knowledge source.
behaviorLead: What counts as an acceptable answer, and how many steps it may take to get there.
temperatureHint: How varied the wording is. Lower is steadier and closer to the source; higher is more varied. Answers that must cite sources work well at 0–0.3.
knowledgeTabLead: Which sources this agent answers from. One conversation, one source — citations must come from it.
retrievalLivesOnKb: How much to retrieve, and whether to rerank, are settings of the knowledge source.
topPHint: Samples only from the more likely candidates; lower is more conservative. Usually tuned instead of temperature, not alongside it.
maxTokensHint: Ceiling for the answer length. Unset uses the default limit.
reasoningEffortHint: How much effort goes into reasoning. Higher is slower and usually more accurate. Applies only while thinking mode is on.
samplingPresetHint: How steady the wording is. Picking one fills the two fields below; both stay editable.
previewContextNote: Everything after "Context from the knowledge base" is filled in with the passages retrieved for the question, so it appears as a placeholder here.
previewAgentsMdEmpty: No instructions written, so no AGENTS.md is produced.
previewAgentsMdNote: The same text appears in the system prompt and is written to AGENTS.md in the session workspace.
previewNeedsSource: Bind a knowledge source first; the model input is read through it.
previewFailed: Could not read the model input.
previewLead: Two texts reach the model: the system prompt is sent with every answer; AGENTS.md is written into the session workspace and read on demand.
promptSectionLead: Two texts with different destinations: the instruction is the body of the system prompt; AGENTS.md is appended as agent memory and written to a workspace file.
systemPromptHint: The body of the system prompt: who this service is, what it answers, how. Empty uses the built-in instruction.
systemPromptPlaceholder: You answer employee questions about HR policy, citing the clauses you rely on.
agentsMdHint: Workspace conventions. Appended to the system prompt as agent memory, and written to AGENTS.md in the session workspace for the file tools.
agentsMdPlaceholder:
# Conventions
Amounts in CNY, two decimal places.
